name: orm-preflight
description: Checks database migrations as Claude writes them. Catches data loss, table locks, and deploy problems in TypeORM migrations, and tells Claude the safe way to make the change.

use_project_install.title: Use the project's own orm-preflight
use_project_install.description: Off by default: the automatic migration check runs the exact orm-preflight version this plugin was released with, downloaded from npm. Turn this on to run the orm-preflight installed in the project folder instead (node_modules/orm-preflight), for example to use its MySQL parser. Parent folders are never searched. The MCP tools always use the released version.
